– Dismantling, testing, installing, and starting a new production line in 4 months would be "insane".

– Production rate is uncertain and cannot be predicted for a new product such as Optimus.

– Simple skills and build up from there.

– The last S/X production will end in May, which the Optimus line will utilize. Some disassembly has already begun, with the rest dismantled after production concludes.

– Installing the new production line will follow shortly after, but will need testing and "several months".

"When will we have the Optimus V3 reveal, and when will production begin? What are production expectations?"

– We want to push the Optimus V3 unveil closer to production, which is somewhere around late July to early August.

Lars (@larsmoravy) has confirmed that the theoretical 2,500 limit for AVs (autonomous vehicles) from the NHTSA does NOT apply to Cybercab, in response to a question from @farzyness.

There are no limitations on Cybercab production beyond the production lines themselves.

We can confirm that 2026.14.2 resolved two bugs reported by some owners who receives 2026.14.1.

Firstly, there was a bug with some phone keys struggling to connect to vehicles. Secondly, TPMS readings were failing in some instances.

Both of these have been resolved in 2026.14.2
